title: Scope doc-link Lint instructions to repositories that ship the checker
outcome: The documented exact doc-link Lint route clearly applies to repositories that provide scripts/check-doc-links.mjs, so readers are not directed to run a missing script in TermAl.
acceptance: The doc-link Lint instructions distinguish repositories that provide the checker from TermAl checkouts where that file is absent.
The correction preserves the exact-command classification, existing Lint admission rules and the distinction from Test credit.
